notes.title: Operating frequency
notes.body:
Data is 5 bytes (10-byte BCD), little-endian. Digit order: byte-1 low = 10 Hz, byte-1 high = 1 Hz, byte-2 low = 1 kHz, byte-2 high = 100 Hz, byte-3 low = 100 kHz, byte-3 high = 10 kHz, byte-4 low = 10 MHz, byte-4 high = 1 MHz, byte-5 low = 1 GHz (0 fixed), byte-5 high = 100 MHz (0-4 on IC-705).
Example: 144.000000 MHz -> 00 00 00 44 01

Commands 00 / 03 / 05 read or set transceive frequency; command 1C 03 reads the transmit frequency in Split.

notes.title: Operating mode
notes.body:
Data is 1-2 bytes.
Byte 1 - operating mode: 00=LSB, 01=USB, 02=AM, 03=CW, 04=RTTY, 05=FM, 06=WFM, 07=CW-R, 08=RTTY-R, 17=DV.
Byte 2 - filter: 01=FIL1, 02=FIL2, 03=FIL3 (optional with commands 01 and 06; FIL1/default selected when omitted).

notes.title: Band edge frequency settings
notes.body:
Band edge frequencies are sent as pairs of BCD-encoded frequencies, one pair per edge:
  byte 1: edge number (01-1E = 1-30) (not returned when reading by command 02)
  bytes 2-6: lower edge frequency (5-byte BCD, same encoding as command 05)
  byte 7: separator 2D (fixed)
  bytes 8-12: higher edge frequency (5-byte BCD)

Command 02 reads band edge frequencies; command 1E 03 reads/sets numbered band edges (command 1E 01 reads them).

notes.title: Scope waveform data
notes.body:
Outputs the waveform data to the controller.
1: 00 (Fixed)
2: Order of division data (Current): 01~11
3:  Division number (Maximum): 01(WLAN), 11(USB)
LWhen data is sent to the controller using
the WLAN function, all data is sent together.
However, when the data is sent through the
[microUSB] port, the data is divided by 11 and
sent in sequential order.
LThe 1st data sends only the wave information
(1 ~ 6) without the waveform data (7). The
2nd or later data sends the minimum wave
information (1 ~ 3) with waveform data (7).
4: Spectrum scope mode data:
• 00 = Center mode scope
• 01 = Fixed mode scope
• 02 = SCROLL-C mode scope
• 03 = SCROLL-F mode scope
5:  Waveform information:
The waveform information differs, depending on
the Spectrum scope mode.
• In the Center mode:
Center frequency and span are sent.
See page 17 for Operating frequency data, and
the Scope span settings (2 ~ 6) on page 29.
• In the Fixed, SCROLL-C, and SCROLL-F modes:
Lower edge and higher edge frequencies are
sent.
